user.title: Choose services
user.description: Choose at least one service to synchronize with Home Assistant and set the polling interval. Changes to Home Assistant Shopping List are synchronized immediately.

listonic_auth.title: Connect to Listonic
listonic_auth.description: Sign in with your Listonic account. Your password is used only to obtain API tokens and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Listonic
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to the same Listonic account. Your selected lists and entity names will be preserved.

bridge.description: Home Assistant: {local_count} items. Listonic “{list_name}”: {remote_count} items. The first merge keeps every item from both lists, including repeated names. Subsequent changes synchronize both ways. If changing lists, pending changes for the previous binding remain saved for that previous list. Configure the built-in Shopping List integration in Home Assistant settings. Items retained for the previous binding: {held_count}. These will not be sent to the new list.

conflict_policy.title: Synchronization conflicts
conflict_policy.description: Choose which version to keep after conflicting edits. Ordinary changes still synchronize both ways. This includes deletions. Manual conflicts wait in Repairs while other products keep synchronizing. An unavailable source or missing ID mapping defers the decision. Uncertain writes need separate verification.

keep_auth.title: Connect Google Keep
keep_auth.description: Keep access uses an unofficial private protocol. Enter the test account email, Android ID, and oauth_token cookie from the setup guide. The cookie is exchanged immediately; Home Assistant stores a master token that can access all Keep notes on that account. A dedicated account is recommended.

conflict.title: Needs resolution
conflict.description: Open integration options and check the list binding. Inspect conflicts and uncertain writes with lists_assistant.get_sync_issues, then use lists_assistant.resolve_sync_conflict or lists_assistant.resolve_sync_write. For a storage error, preserve the data file and check logs before restoring a backup.

sync_conflicts.title: Shopping List conflicts: {count} ({source})
sync_conflicts.description: Choose the versions to keep and review the preview before confirming. Other products continue synchronizing.

choose.title: Resolve conflicts together
choose.description: Choose the source to keep. Deletions on that side will be propagated to the other list.

confirm.title: Confirm decisions ({count})
confirm.description:
{preview}

∅ means deleted, [x] completed, [ ] needs action. Confirming saves decisions in the queue. Synchronization may wait for a connection.

error.unavailable: A safe preview is unavailable. Check connectivity, mappings and uncertain writes.
error.changed: The list changed. Review the updated preview and confirm again.

abort.storage_error: Decisions could not be saved. Synchronization has stopped.

sync_all.name: Synchronize all connected lists
sync_all.description: Run every configured Shopping List bridge for this account and wait for its current work to finish.

sync_listonic.name: Synchronize Listonic
sync_listonic.description: Refresh Listonic and reconcile its selected list with Home Assistant Shopping List.

sync_gkeep.name: Synchronize Google Keep
sync_gkeep.description: Refresh Google Keep and reconcile its selected list with Home Assistant Shopping List.

get_sync_issues.name: Show synchronization issues
get_sync_issues.description: Return pending writes and conflicts for the Listonic and Google Keep bridges.

resolve_keep_write.name: Resolve an uncertain Google Keep write
resolve_keep_write.description: Confirm the result after inspecting Home Assistant and Google Keep.

resolve_keep_conflict.name: Resolve a Google Keep synchronization conflict
resolve_keep_conflict.description: Choose which version to keep after an edit or deletion conflict.

get_lists.name: Read lists and products
get_lists.description: Return all accessible active lists and products for this account, including their IDs and metadata.

create_list.name: Create a list
create_list.description: Create a cloud list. Returns list_id when a response is requested. Select it in integration options to add its todo entity.

rename_list.name: Rename a list
rename_list.description: Rename the list with the specified numeric ID.

delete_list.name: Deactivate a list
delete_list.description: Deactivate the list using Active:0. Its todo entity becomes unavailable. This is not a confirmed permanent deletion.

add_item.name: Add a product
add_item.description: Add a product with optional metadata. Returns item_id when a response is requested.

update_item.name: Update a product
update_item.description: Change only the supplied fields. Empty amount, unit or description clears that field. Price 0 sets the price to zero.

delete_item.name: Delete a product
delete_item.description: Delete the product with the specified numeric ID from this list.
